decision_rationale: The record presents a new multimodal generative framework, not a review or wrapper. It uses scRNA-seq as the biological input and a pretrained LLM decoder to generate natural-language cell descriptions, so both the text component and the text-bio bridge are substantive.
evidence_snippet: “Cell2Text, a multimodal generative framework that translates scRNA-seq profiles into structured natural language descriptions”; “projects each gene embedding to the natural language semantic space”; “a pretrained, instruction-tuned LLM decoder then generates structured natural language descriptions”.
